where: dock and lower village area on the left
desc: The dense overlap of roofs, wooden platforms, and walkways makes it hard to distinguish navigable paths from drop-offs into the water.

verify.why: The strong visual contrast between the blue water and the wooden walkways and stairs makes navigable surfaces easily distinguishable.

where: below the central platform structures
desc: Deep pitch-black shadows beneath the upper deck obscure the ground details and potential walkable paths beneath.

verify.why: The area beneath the platform is well-lit with ambient light, leaving barrels, crates, and architecture clearly visible.

where: mid-left platform edge
desc: The diagonal pulley rail clips through the wooden platform edge without a cut-out.

verify.why: The pulley rail structure runs alongside the platform edge rather than clipping through the wooden flooring.

where: center middle ground platform and roofs
desc: Overlapping roof structures and dark shadow contrast obscure the walkable pathways, making it unclear where the player can safely walk.

verify.why: The main wooden walkways and platform paths are clearly readable and continuous throughout the scene.

where: bottom left roof intersecting cliff face
desc: The roof structure clips directly into the rock wall on the left without any fitting edge or surrounding frame.

verify.why: The roof at the bottom left extends toward the frame edge naturally beside the cliff face rather than visually clipping into it.

where: center ground path in deep shadow
desc: Deep, pitch-black cast shadows completely obscure the ground terrain, making elevation changes and path boundaries impossible to read.

verify.why: The shadowed path area retains visible ground textures and clear contrast, making terrain details easy to read.

where: top left wooden framework attached to cliff
desc: Wooden platform beams clip directly into the raw cliff rock without supporting joints or wall anchors.

verify.why: Embedding wooden beams directly into rock geometry is a standard environment art practice for cliffside structures and does not impede gameplay.

where: upper right background cavern wall
desc: The background geometry terminates into flat black unlit void spaces without distance fog or natural lighting integration.

verify.why: The upper right background features visible rock geometry and distant lit structures rather than an unlit void.

where: lower left multi-tiered walkways
desc: Harsh black shadows completely obscure the elevation, layout, and boundaries of lower-level walkways.

verify.why: The lower-left walkways are illuminated by lanterns and direct light, leaving paths, fences, and elevation changes clearly visible.

itemWhat: the way out of this area on foot towards loop-stairs — a path that carries on out of the frame
desc: the way out of this area on foot towards loop-stairs: ABSENT — No path leading out towards loop-stairs is visible in this frame.

verify.why: A clear stepped stone staircase leading down the cliff face is prominently visible on the right side.

where: walkway in the center of the frame
desc: Extremely deep shadows obscure the wooden walkway, making it difficult to discern walkable pathways from open drops.

verify.why: The cast shadows across the walkway do not obscure the path or make boundaries hard to distinguish.

where: shadowed area beneath left building
desc: Deep pitch-black shadows completely black out the geometry beneath the upper-left building, making it impossible to discern depth or spatial layout.

verify.why: The area beneath the upper-left building clearly shows vertical support pillars, hanging banners, and visible wall geometry rather than pitch-black darkness.

where: deep shadow in central cliff cavity
desc: Deep pitch-black shadows obscure the cavity behind the stairs, making it impossible to tell if there is a path or ledge inside.

verify.why: The central cavity is not completely pitch-black, as a lit doorway with an illuminated lantern is clearly visible inside at the top.

where: dark shadowed recess in central cliff
desc: Harsh direct lighting casts a deep shadow over the central cliff recess, completely obscuring paths and doorways.

verify.why: The shadow does not completely obscure pathways or doorways, as the illuminated passageway and lantern inside the cliff recess remain visible.

where: large boat structure on the left
desc: The large boat hull is perched at an impossibly steep tilt over small wooden shacks without realistic support.

verify.why: The tilted boat hull is an intentional stylized design element supported by visible wooden posts and underlying structures.

where: timber framework in upper center
desc: Exposed skeletal timber framing appears incomplete and floats disconnected from adjacent buildings.

verify.why: The timber framework is grounded on vertical support posts along the cliff face rather than floating in air.

where: central circular wooden platform
desc: The central circular wooden platform is completely enclosed by a railing with no visible openings, stairs, or connected paths.

verify.why: The railing only borders the front curve of the platform, leaving the sides and rear open to adjacent walkways.

where: central circular wooden platform
desc: The elevated platform has no visible stairs, steps, or ramps connecting it to lower or higher ground levels, making navigable routes unclear.

verify.why: The platform sits flush with the adjacent building walkway on the left, forming a continuous navigable route.

where: shadowed area under the upper right structures
desc: Deep cast shadows completely obscure the ground terrain and potential pathways along the cliffside behind the main walkway.

verify.why: Ground terrain, props, and vegetation remain clearly visible beneath the upper structures despite being in shadow.

where: far right end of the long wooden walkway
desc: The main wooden walkway ends abruptly at the right edge without any stairs, ladder, or clear connection leading up into the village.

verify.why: A pier terminating at a dead end on one side is standard level design, as primary access to the village is provided via the dock structure on the left.

where: stairs in center middle ground
desc: The stair steps float in mid-air without side stringers or structural beams anchoring them.

verify.why: The stair treads are anchored from beneath by a central spine stringer rather than floating without support.

where: green tree cones on cliff face
desc: The conical trees stick horizontally out of the vertical rock wall without roots or supporting ledges.

verify.why: Simplified cone trees placed along steep terrain are standard for this low-poly stylized art direction.
